context: Checks that the rollout plan follows the nx-bun-integration workflow: install, convert, cache, pilot validation with recovery, then affected-only rollout.

checklist.name: Installs the plugin as a dev dependency
checklist.description: The plan includes `bun add -D @nx-bun/nx` as the first step.

checklist.name: Initialises the plugin with the init generator
Uses the convert generator for existing projects
checklist.description: The plan converts an existing project with `nx g @nx-bun/nx:convert-to-bun --project=<name>`.

checklist.name: Configures cache inputs and outputs before rollout
checklist.description: The plan configures cache inputs and outputs for the build and test targets before widening the rollout.

checklist.name: Validates one pilot project first
checklist.description: The plan runs build, test and serve on a single pilot project before any other project is converted.

checklist.name: Requires exit code 0 from the pilot commands
checklist.description: The plan states all three pilot commands must exit with code 0 before proceeding.

checklist.name: Recovery path inspects project.json executor configuration
checklist.description: If validation fails, the plan says to check the executor configuration in `project.json`.

checklist.name: Recovery path runs nx reset then retries
checklist.description: If validation fails, the plan says to run `nx reset` and retry.

checklist.name: Resolves all failures before rolling out
checklist.description: The plan forbids rolling out to remaining projects until every pilot failure is resolved.

checklist.name: Rolls out to affected projects only
checklist.description: The rollout step targets affected projects rather than rebuilding all twelve.

checklist.name: CI uses nx affected with lint, test and build
checklist.description: The CI command is `bun nx affected -t lint,test,build` with `--base=main` and a `--parallel` limit.

checklist.name: Avoids: validating only in hot mode
checklist.description: Failure avoided: the plan validates only with a hot or watch serve and never runs a non-hot production-oriented run.
